name: Dr. Priya Sharma
personal_statement: I have dedicated 20 years to understanding the universe from the ground. I want to understand it from space. My conditional medical clearance relates to a fully managed thyroid condition that has not affected my performance in any simulation or physical assessment. I acknowledge the flight hours gap and have enrolled in an accelerated programme. I bring scientific capability that is genuinely rare in this candidate class.
psychological_profile: Highly motivated, exceptional scientific credentials. Realistic and self-aware about gaps. Psychological resilience scores strong despite limited operational background. Conditional clearance and low flight hours are the primary risk factors for this cycle.
